text_block_list.text:
Today is the Takamatsunomiya Kinen...
It's my first target race since changing my training regimen.
Waking up early with a strange premonition, I head toward the track—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!?
Why...?

Just as I thought. Nishino Flower couldn't
seem to shake off her pre-race anxiety.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, it was completely obvious, wasn't it?
That I'm feeling... a tiny bit uneasy.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna do this! I'll give it my all!"
...I really was all fired up to do it.
And yet...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm always such a scaredy-cat...
Even though my body is growing into an adult's, my heart is still just a little child's.

"There's no need to force yourself to change."
"You're fine just the way you are"... Neither feels quite right.
If I can't find the perfect words, I should just speak from the heart—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
C... cool, you say?
Me!?

Skipping grades meant almost everyone around her was older,
yet she worked hard and kept running with all her might.
Even now, she is giving her all to overcome the next wall.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
So cool...!
I'm... so cool...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, I'm bursting with so much courage!
Trainer-san, you're so good at watering me...♪
choice_data_list: Let's go show off the new flower!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha!
My body feels so light, so light!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I feel in top shape to Bakushin forward!
Speed truly is power, and power is speed!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Indeed, your condition is truly magnificent. I can see lightning coursing within you, Bakushin O-san...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
At this distance, your brilliance flashes all the brighter.
Even so, I have no intention of letting you take the lead.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: To you, too... and to this lovely flower.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In other words, does that mean I'm faster than light?!
Thank you very much, I look forward to working with you today!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Then Zephyr-san, why don't you chant it too!
Saying it out loud is super refreshing!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Now, Bakushi-i-in!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Bakushin.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (The older girls are so fired up... That's right, everyone's doing their best.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Still, I want to... too!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Flower-san.
The wind has shifted, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"The wind direction...
Ah, that's right!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, I'll take on the challenge as a brand-new me!
I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I see.
So that was the case.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how fragrant the flowers will be...
I'm looking forward to finding out.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm... looking forward to it too!
